name: airlock
description: Routes supported project edits into a Git worktree for review, accept or reject. Worktree routing is not a filesystem sandbox.

mode.title: Command policy mode
mode.description: strict denies classified external effects and git-topology commands; balanced asks once for matched external effects (denies headless); permissive allows and records classified actions. Unmatched commands pass in every mode; this heuristic is not a sandbox.

includeUntracked.title: Include untracked files
includeUntracked.description: Copy non-ignored regular untracked files into the baseline (default on); ignored files are excluded, while symlinks, directories, and files over 4 MiB are skipped.

retainRejectedTransactions.title: Retain rejected transactions
retainRejectedTransactions.description: Keep rejected or aborted transaction worktrees for inspection instead of destroying them

maxStoredTransactions.title: History size
maxStoredTransactions.description: How many finished transaction records to keep per repository
